paragraphSteps: AI RMF 1.0 was released in January 2023 for voluntary use, with a stated trustworthiness aim across AI activities.
AI 600-1 was published in July 2024 as a cross-sector generative AI profile prepared pursuant to Executive Order 14110.
The publications are framed together as broad guidance and a focused companion profile, without implying replacement or a private-sector compliance requirement.
